programs.sub_title: Pups Save Thundermouth; Pups Save a Class Pet
programs.desc: Shortly after listening to the story of Thundermouth, the pups are on a mission to save elephants spooked by a scary noise; Mayor Goodway is left in charge of a class pet, but the hamster escapes.

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.desc: Daisy and Mr. Crocodile find a tiny lizard who idolizes Mr. Crocodile; Winston leads a nature hike, but his gadget gets everyone lost in the woods.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save the Kitties and the Kiddies; Pups Save the Greenhouse
programs.desc: Humdinger's hands are full when he babysits his new friend's kids; Everest helps the pups rescue both mayors trapped inside a greenhouse.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Katie's Arctic Road Trip; Pups Save a Magical Mishap
programs.desc: Skye, Everest, Liberty, and Katie go on a camping adventure where they encounter a polar bear with a sweet tooth; when Julia and Julius put on a magic show, they are convinced they accidentally turned Mr. Carter into a rabbit.

programs.title: Rubble & Crew
programs.sub_title: The Crew Builds a Giant Checkerboard; The Crew Builds a Corn Silo
programs.desc: Rubble and Wheeler team up to construct a solution for a mysterious mess on Farmer Zoe's farm; coach Karima is throwing Checkers Day for all the Builder Cove kids; when everyone can't play together, Rubble and Crew save the day with construction.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Windswept Polar Bear Cub; Pups Save a Drive-In
programs.desc: When a windstorm sends a polar bear cub down to Adventure Bay, it's up to Ryder, Everest, and the pups to bring the baby bear back to its family; the pups must save Mayor Humdinger from a runaway movie projector.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Liberty's Mountain Rescue; Pups Save a Flying Farmer Yumi
programs.desc: Liberty comes to visit the pups just in time to help save the Turbots and their radar Doppler in a daring mountain rescue; when Farmer Al builds a windmill, the wind takes Farmer Yumi and Garby on a wild flight.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Mighty Pups vs. the Big Chill; Mighty Pups vs. the Mighty Cheetah
programs.desc: Harold creates a ray that can freeze things instantly, it goes awry and sends a giant ice ball toward Adventure Bay; the Cheetah snatches half of Chase's Meteor Crystal, Chase must stop the Cheetah and restore his crystal.

programs.title: The Smurfs
programs.sub_title: Fire Brigade on Foot; The Prettiest Pebble in the World
programs.desc: Dimwitty and Clumsy decide to get rid of the fire truck so that they no longer argue about it, but it is very difficult to put out a fire on foot; Gargamel leaves magic pebbles in the forest to hypnotize the Smurfs.

programs.title: Sonic Prime
programs.desc: To get help in the fight against Nine and his winged lackeys, Sonic heads to New Yoke and forms an allegiance with the very last people he ever expected.

programs.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programs.desc: Bikini Bottom is the place to be this Saturday night for all the newest episodes of "SpongeBob.".

programs.title: The Patrick Star Show
